jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead - Product
jobs.description:
About Eve

Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how  law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

About the Role

We are looking for a Strategic Finance Lead to serve as a strategic thought partner to our Product and Engineering organizations. In this role, you will help shape how Eve evaluates product performance, prioritizes investments, thinks about pricing and monetization, and plans for future growth. You will translate product performance, customer behavior, business trends, and financial information into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership and the Executive Leadership Team. You will not be expected to build analytics infrastructure or own the production of dashboards. Instead, you will partner closely with our Analytics and Data teams to define the questions that matter, interpret the data, and turn analysis into sound business decisions

Required Qualifications

- 5-8+ years of experience in strategic finance, product finance, FP&A, investment banking, management consulting, growth finance, or a related field, ideally including experience at a high-growth technology company.

- Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, or other business leaders on growth, investment, pricing, monetization, or strategic planning decisions.

- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including experience building forecasts, business cases, financial models, and analyses that connect business performance to strategic decisions.

- Strong business judgment and the ability to evaluate opportunities, tradeoffs, and risks in a fast-moving and evolving environment.

- Experience working with product, customer, operational, and financial data to understand business performance and inform decision-making.

- Ability to partner effectively with Analytics and Data teams, including the ability to define the questions and business problems that need to be solved and translate analytical outputs into actionable recommendations.

- Ability to translate complex financial and business information into clear, concise recommendations for senior leadership.

- High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, combined with comfort making decisions when data is imperfect and the business is evolving.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready materials and communicate effectively with senior leaders.

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Product Finance, Strategic Finance, FP&A, or a similar role at a high-growth SaaS, technology, AI, or software company.

- Experience supporting product-led, usage-based, subscription, or other recurring-revenue business models.

- Experience evaluating pricing, packaging, monetization, or product economics.

- Experience building business cases and financial models for new products, strategic initiatives, or significant investments.

- Experience working in an AI, legal technology, or other rapidly evolving technology environment.

- Experience partnering with data and analytics teams to support product and business decision-making.

- Experience working in a company undergoing rapid growth and organizational scaling

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Eve and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

US Salary Range
$185,000 — $235,000 USD
